analyst_view.overall: Early view: Inter play this three days after hosting Stuttgart in the Champions League, so Chivu may rotate. Lautaro has been out with a muscle injury since 15 October and Bonny was hurt against Como, leaving Thuram and Pio Esposito as the main strikers. Genoa lost 2-1 at home to Milan but out-shot them, after three straight wins including one over Juventus.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.0 goals. I lean slightly higher: Inter's home games have averaged 4.4 goals, with Inter scoring 3.2 a game at San Siro. Genoa's away games are low-scoring, and Inter may rotate after Stuttgart, so this is a small lean.

corners.text: The site expects 9.6 corners. I lean lower because Inter's home games have averaged only about 8.2: they score from cut-backs and counters rather than from corners, and opponents take only about two corners a game at San Siro. Genoa's away games have averaged about 7.4.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.3 cards. I lean slightly lower: Inter's home games have averaged only about two cards, and Inter commit few fouls when they are in control. Genoa do pick up about two bookings a game, which keeps the lean small.

shots.text: The site expects 28.0 shots. Inter's home games average about 31, but a rotated Inter three days after Stuttgart may not keep up that pace, and Genoa shoot only about ten times a game away. Those cancel out, so I stay with the number.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.9 shots on target. I lean higher: Inter's home games have averaged about 11 on target, with Inter themselves near eight. Genoa rarely hit the target away, so nearly all of the extra comes from Inter.
